messages.subject: What is the data upload limit in free and starter solutions
parts:
I remember failing to upload csv ot tsv files under free few months ago and had to add a limit my code to avoid problems.
I do not mean the instance size (I used 1GB) but some upload limit (is it one and the same?).
Such limit does not seem to be present in the online info, was it removed?

# options(shiny.maxRequestSize=1000*1024^2)
# the following test checks if we are running on shinnyapps.io to limit file size dynamically
# ref: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/31423144/how-to-know-if-the-app-is-running-at-local-or-on-server-r-shiny/31425801#31425801
if ( Sys.getenv('SHINY_PORT') == "" ) { options(shiny.maxRequestSize=1000*1024^2) }

Can someone refresh me with the current UL limit for free and starter?
Is this answer up-to-date and answering my question (https://groups.google.com/forum/#!newtopic/shinyapps-users/shinyapps-users/4zGu2CTAbxc)

Thanks
Stephane
